candidate.title: CHART
candidate.scope: The middle poster row labelled CHART (Capture hybridization analysis of RNA targets), at schematic scope: crosslink/lysis, biotinylated-probe hybridization, bead capture/wash/elution, and alternative DNA extraction or protein Western blot analysis. The supplied catalogue heading and matching operation labels identify this as CHART despite its erroneous caption A schematic overview of ChIRP. Neighbouring ChIRP and RAP rows, partial FRT-seq labels above, and the chemical legend at right are contextual and have no connecting route into CHART. This is not a complete executable protocol or a claim that all CHART implementations are identical. The poster ends at recovered DNA; sequencing is a catalogue-supported readout interface, not a drawn library-preparation operation.

operations.label: Crosslink and lyse cells
operations.description: Converts cell-associated lncRNA–chromatin material into a crosslinked lysate containing RNA–DNA–protein complexes. The catalogue describes fragmentation as part of this preparation; no separate fragmentation operation is drawn in CHART.
operations.mechanism: Crosslinking retains associations in the extract; the primary abstract characterizes the crosslinks as reversible. Lysis makes this material available for capture.
operations.information_effect: Preserves RNA-associated genomic DNA and protein in recoverable complexes, rather than measuring free RNA abundance.
